purpose: R1.13 Phase 5C-1 — durable story fingerprints + LIMITED candidate discovery, explicitly NOT a merge (ADR-0043). PURE versioned fingerprints (src/domain/editorial/story-fingerprints.ts), at most THREE signals per stored item: the stored canonical_url VERBATIM (no fetch, no case/param/path guessing); a content_hash digest of the FULL title+body composition (exactly buildFullEvidenceText) INDEPENDENT of sourceItemId/sourceId (the stored source_items.content_hash is snapshot identity and is NOT reused as a cross-source text fingerprint); and a weak title_key under the ONE limited normalization (NFC + whitespace collapse + trim — never case folding, never Persian-Latin digit, negation, or unit equivalence). Canonical framing is LENGTH-PREFIXED (collision-safe by construction and test); every digest is a fixed-length SHA-256 hex; raw text/URL never stored as an index value. INDEX CONTRACT (multi-owner, ZERO new DDL, schema stays 3): the EXISTING story_fingerprints(kind,value) PK carries sc1:<64-hex digest>:<storyId> values with kind url/content_hash/title_key — many stories can share one digest while each (story, signal) stays ONE row; writes are plain fenced INSERT..SELECT with NOT EXISTS on the story's OWN row (idempotent replay) — INSERT OR REPLACE and silent collision overrides are FORBIDDEN; historical rows without sc1: are NOT reinterpreted and historical stories are NOT backfilled. HANDLER WIRING: editorial.prepare_draft performs AT MOST 3 parameterized prefix-range lookups (LIMIT 9 rows each — the 9th row detects overflow; self story excluded; no wildcards, no full scan) STRICTLY after early validation/reuse and BEFORE any provider work; a lookup DB error is NEVER a fabricated empty success — it maps to the engine's typed bounded retry with ZERO provider calls and ZERO AI charges. The versioned candidateDiscovery report (discoveryVersion 1; typed reader validating the REAL v1 invariants — the R1.12.1 lesson applied from birth; absent/unsupported_version/malformed stay distinct) rides INSIDE drafts.document_json next to evidenceGuard by the SAME fenced atomic batch that writes the draft AND the new story's fingerprints (max 3 extra INSERT statements, every one carrying the SAME ownership/generation/lease fence AND snapshot predicate — a lost fence or changed snapshot writes NO draft AND NO fingerprint). HONEST BOUNDARIES: candidates are a PROPOSAL at the lookup moment — equal URL/text/title NEVER proves one event or independent sources; NOTHING merges, no duplicate marking, no supersede, no evidence-stance change, no confidence/trust raise, no truth verification, no auto-approval path; overflow is recorded (9-row probe, max 8 unique candidates with an explicit candidatesTruncated flag); nothing found reads no_candidates_observed (never unique_story/no_related_story); concurrent commits may not see each other (exactly-once discovery NOT claimed); replay/reuse happens BEFORE lookup/provider (no backfill, no rewritten report, no fresh charge). This is NOT semantic matching, NOT entity aliasing, NOT AI adjudication, NOT the full Fact Guard — merge/adjudication and live ingestion remain future. Application version synced 1.7.1 -> 1.8.0 across ALL active references (package.json; package-lock.json ROOT metadata ONLY; wrangler.jsonc APP_VERSION root+preview; phase0 DEFAULT_APP_VERSION; .env.example; .dev.vars.example; tests/helpers/test-env.ts; the active test assertions). SCHEMA STAYS 3 — no migration; the round adds ZERO SQL DDL and ZERO new SQL files.
